title: Submission branches are transport envelopes
summary: The canonical ooRexx sender validates a finished package, creates a fresh autobuild-submit branch from accepted origin/main, commits package body first, commits ready.json last, and publishes both commits in one push. Submission branches are not development branches and are never merged into main.
invariants: ready.json is the immutable go marker and must be committed last.
Corrections use a new submission id; never mutate a ready submission.
Do not merge or rebase submission branches into main.
Do not write accepted package trees directly to main.
One push transfers the body and ready commits together.

provenance.claim: Sender implementation: detached worktree, ready-last, one-push publication.
